#073 · Jellyfish Pokémon

Tentacruel

Water Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Tentacruel is a Water/Poison-type Jellyfish Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 55 kg. It evolves from Tentacool. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (120), with a base stat total of 515.
